methodology: Every exact distinct keyword has one action; sourceRecords retain every original ranking row.
Volume and KD remain source estimates as supplied; no KD or minimum-volume exclusion rule.

One create record per new/local-draft intent cluster; strong synonyms have merge actions. Every keyword assigned to an already usable page has an existing action. Existing targets were checked in this baseline sitemap and their HTML inspected.
Broad-topic pages must answer their informational task using sourced content before offering the Tracer. The Tracer alone is not represented as coaching, analytics, recording, scoring or recruiting.
Deferred phrases require missing capability, factual resources or intent verification. No empty or misleading landing page is created.
This is a local production plan, not a forecast of indexing, search clicks or conversions.

HomeCourt brand queries are not automatically excluded: existing independent guides and the confirmed training-app page may cover their app-information intent. Mapping explicitly does not claim to satisfy every navigational, venue or game interpretation.
